h2: Explore every Container Office size & its applications
intro: Nine engineered sizes on one container platform — pick the footprint that matches your team, site and crane plan, with fixed ex-factory rates and Pan India delivery.

panels.h3: 10×10 ft — the gate and supervisor unit
panels.paragraph: One room, one lift: 100 sq ft for a gate supervisor, weighbridge operator or security-adjacent office. The smallest unit that still carries the full container platform — heavy base, insulated shell, DB-protected electricals.
A trailer-friendly module for tight laydown areas: one to two workstations with storage along a slim body. The size that fits where a full-width unit cannot.
Our most-specified container office: 200 sq ft seating three to four with desks, files and a visitor chair. Delivered fitted — electricals, lighting, insulation — and craned straight onto your pad.

panels.h3: 20×12 ft — the office with a meeting table
panels.paragraph: Two extra feet of width turn the standard office into a room that also hosts meetings — workstations plus a table, one module, no site construction.
A 300 sq ft engineering bay: multiple desks, documentation and storage in one 30-ft module that still moves as a single crane lift.
The long slim format for ports, yards and linear projects — a corridor-style run of workstations riding a standard 40 ft trailer.
A square 400 sq ft floor from twin container modules — two bays for team plus meetings, delivered with ODC routing and joined on site.
The standard large-site administration unit: a full 40-ft module with team seating and a manager partition option — one lift, one working office.
480 sq ft in one engineered unit — the most office you can place in a single ODC lift before stacking or joining modules for a larger complex.
